newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends higher as bank stocks surge.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends higher as bank stocks surge.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index finished higher for the eighth consecutive session on Thursday boosted by sharp gains in banking stocks and a firm start in New York.
But traders said gains were capped in the run-up to next Thurday's election and volume remained slim at 699 million.
"We are struggling at the 4,400 level," one dealer said. "There was a lack of follow-through buying today and things were dampened by the bond market which was very dull."
The leading index ended just 0.8 points firmer at 4,388.5 after earlier touching 4,400.4.
